nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: No tools attached, on purpose. The agent proposes a slotId from a list Spring supplied; Spring validates it again and performs the write. Giving the agent a booking tool would mean giving n8n a credential and letting a model decide a slot was free - which only a transaction can decide.

nodes.name: Google Vertex Chat Model
nodes.notes: Project id is filled in. Set Region to asia-southeast1 if the node offers it (default inherits the credential's, which is global). maxOutputTokens 2048 because gemini-2.5-flash charges its reasoning tokens against this budget - at 400 it spent ~490 thinking and truncated the reply mid-sentence.

nodes.name: Simple Memory
nodes.notes: Keyed on sessionKey from Spring. The default fixed key would make every client in the spa share one conversation.
